messages.subject: R is not a Non-R language
parts: I noticed that there are many projects that list "R" under the "Non-R languages?" column of the projects table. https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects FYI if you project does not use any other languages than R, than you can just leave this blank.
